name: Authorized-scope estate coverage
questionAnswered: What fraction of the independently enumerated asset units in the named authorized scope has at least one admitted current observation?

calculation.formula: observed in-scope asset units divided by independently enumerated in-scope asset units
calculation.numeratorDefinition: Distinct denominator asset units linked to at least one admitted, non-stale observation within the named assessment scope.
calculation.denominatorDefinition: Distinct in-scope asset units enumerated by the referenced authoritative denominator source and frozen at the stated as-of time.
calculation.rounding: Retain six decimal places in machine output; display percentages may round to one decimal place.

scopeSemantics.qualification: The denominator must name its asset unit, authority, exclusions, and freeze time; no denominator means no percentage.

interpretation.doesMean: The stated fraction of independently enumerated units in the named scope has admitted evidence meeting the stated freshness rule.
doesNotMean: The complete enterprise estate has been discovered.
Observed assets are correctly configured or quantum safe.
Risk has been accepted or remediation completed.
interpretation.whenUnavailable: Show unavailable with the missing denominator as an evidence limitation; do not infer a denominator from observed records.
